Lifestyle Enclave

A home taking shape around everyday life.

An apartment community under construction in the Nova Scotia landscape.

About this development +

Lifestyle Enclave is a 102-unit residential community in Upper Hammonds Plains. Thoughtfully considered apartment layouts connect private living spaces with shared places to meet, unwind and feel at home.

The community includes 48 one-bedroom plus den residences of approximately 780 square feet and 54 two-bedroom plus den residences of approximately 1,040 square feet. In-suite laundry, five-appliance kitchens and ducted heating and air conditioning are included. Shared amenities include a fitness centre, resident lounge, community room, meeting and multipurpose rooms, green spaces, a mailroom and two elevators. The official project site currently lists a planned move-in beginning in October 2026. Availability, pricing, parking, storage and timing remain subject to confirmation by the leasing team.
